stories.title: Farage wins Clacton by-election, skips his own count
new_facts: Electoral watchdog has reopened investigation into Farage's £5m gift after election win.
Farage received over 22,000 votes; Count Binface received under 10,000 votes.
Count Binface took over a quarter of the vote (more than 25%).
Farage received 22,239 votes; Count Binface received 9,455 votes.
Only two of 34 candidates secured enough votes to reclaim their deposit; one candidate got seven votes.
Count Binface declared himself 'the winning candidate who bothered to turn up', claiming over one in four voters backed him.
Mainstream parties shunned the poll as a stunt; Farage increased his vote total versus his previous result.
Farage surpassed his previous Clacton vote of 21,225 from over two years ago.
Farage wins the Clacton by-election and returns to UK parliament.
Count Binface finished second in the Clacton by-election.
Farage won with 62.8% of the vote; donor named as Christopher Harborne; donation figure is £5 million; Farage missed the count citing a threat.
Farage announced he would not attend the count; other notable candidates include Howling Laud Hope and Marcus White.
Farage claimed victory before official results were announced and said he would skip the count.
stories.line: Farage wins his UK Parliament seat in a by-election but skips the count, citing security threats and dismissing opponents as jokes.

stories.title: US doubles down on China tariffs, targets drone technology
new_facts: White House report accuses dozens of countries of helping China avoid tariffs via transshipments, costing tens of billions annually.
White House imposes new tariffs on drones and components, including 100% levy on sensitive models, to cut Chinese tech reliance.
stories.line: The White House is imposing 100% tariffs on Chinese drones and components, while accusing dozens of countries of helping China circumvent existing tariffs.

stories.title: Trump uses budget tactic to trim Medicaid, restrict gender care
new_facts: Trump admin refused to renew Arkansas Medicaid waiver, threatening hundreds of thousands of enrollees' coverage.
CMS finalized a rule this week on gender-affirming care coverage; legal challenges expected but seen as harder to mount.
stories.line: Trump administration is using budget reconciliation to reshape Medicaid and restrict gender-affirming care, facing legal challenges.

stories.title: Five years into Taliban rule, Afghan streets safer but economy and women's rights deteriorate
new_facts: Afghanistan marks 5 years of Taliban rule; safer streets noted but jobs and education lacking.
Nearly 70,000 Afghan evacuees admitted to US on humanitarian parole still lack permanent legal status.
Taliban decrees have erased Afghan women from public life across study, work, travel and independence.
stories.line: Five years after the Taliban takeover, Afghanistan has reduced street crime but faces economic collapse, mass joblessness, and systematic exclusion of women from public roles.
